description:
A university sustainability office needs three specific Emoncms feeds to be publicly accessible so an external dashboard vendor can poll them without authentication.

Navigate to the Feeds page in Emoncms and set the following three feeds to have PUBLIC access enabled:

1. 'campus_grid_power' (tagged 'campus_energy')
2. 'solar_array_output' (tagged 'campus_energy')
3. 'main_hall_temperature' (tagged 'campus_environment')

All three feeds currently have public access DISABLED. For each feed, open its configuration/edit dialog on the Feeds list page, enable the 'Public' setting, and save. Only these three feeds should be made public — do not change any other feeds.

After completing the task, all three feeds should be readable via the Emoncms public API without requiring an API key.
